scope: NeuralCloud working tree: configurable web body, shared dialogue and autonomous observation
verified_behaviors: Independent search and read capability negotiation
Shared cognition search, extraction and single final response commit
Autonomous search followed by read on the next opportunity
Scoped source references and user links distinguished from fetched evidence
Partial extraction propagated without claiming full-page verification
Persistent quota and no replay after uncertain POST
Concurrent controllers do not dispatch the same identity twice
Search replay does not overwrite previously read content
Journal failure does not erase the durable completed request
Private immutable configuration revisions activated on restart
Legacy mode and unconfigured installations remain disabled
limitations: Provider calls used httpx MockTransport; real Tavily service was not called
Shared cognition integration used an isolated test model; real-model online behavior remains unverified
One POSIX permissions test was skipped on Windows
Two existing Starlette and anyio deprecation warnings remain
Production shared services were not restarted and no QQ messages were sent
